svg.text: Authentication • Rate Limiting • Load Balancing • Request Routing
1️⃣ Code Indexing: IDE → API Gateway → Indexing Service → Message Queue → Embedding Service → Qdrant
2️⃣ Code Search: IDE → API Gateway → Search Service → Embedding Service (query) → Qdrant (similarity) → IDE
3️⃣ AI Completion: IDE → API Gateway → Context Engine → Search + PostgreSQL → LLM Service → External AI → IDE
4️⃣ Monitoring: All Services → Prometheus (metrics) + Jaeger (traces) + ELK (logs) → Grafana → Alerts
